summary: Clallam County ridge lookout: 1952 L-4 cab, removed 1970. Willhite's photos show an anchor bolt and battery dump at the site, reached by a gated gravel road.

facts.design: L-4 cab; the Forestry Division annual report, as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page, calls the 1952 building a replacement 14 x 14 ground house
facts.status_note: Removed in 1970. Willhite's photo captions show an anchor bolt and battery dump just below the site fence.

staffing.status: Newspaper items only: an emergency lookout in 1958, and a planned June 1964 manning

access.note: A gate sits partway up the access road and was open on one visit. No source says whether visitors are welcome at the communications site.

visit.drive_up: Public roads reach almost to the site; from the parking area at the top, walk about 0.1 miles past the gate
visit.trail_note: Willhite's directions start at Highway 101: north on Highway 112 for 2 miles, then a dirt road west to a parking area at the top

events.note: L-4 cab on the middle ridgetop; the annual report calls it a replacement 14 x 14 ground house. Firelookout.com says it replaced an earlier lookout one mile north; unconfirmed.
Mrs. Norman Cowan served as emergency lookout from Friday to Monday (Port Angeles Evening News, as quoted)
Newspaper item said seven lookouts would be manned in June, Ellis Mountain among them. A plan, not a confirmed season.
Register, Willhite and the Forest Lookouts page say removed; firelookout.com says destroyed
FFLOS US 1179, WA 80; registered December 20, 2011; nominated by Ray Kresek

notes_for_editor: Built date 1952 is consistent across the register, firelookout.com, Willhite and the Forest Lookouts page. The earlier lookout one mile north (firelookout.com) is unconfirmed: Willhite found no structures in 1952 aerial photos. Removal word conflicts: removed (register, Willhite, Forest Lookouts) vs destroyed (firelookout.com). Access level 'restricted' is our judgment from the gate; no source says whether visitors are welcome. Staffing evidence is two newspaper items relayed by the Forest Lookouts page; the 1964 item is a plan, not confirmed staffing. Brief record checks out: 2,338 ft is 712.6 m, and the FFLOS registration date is December 20, 2011. Fact-check 2026-10-09: removed the 'Olympic Peninsula' location (no source read names it) and footnoted the gate and directions sentences in the story. Willhite's photo captions are not added as photos because no image URLs were extracted.
